indication_area: Metastatic squamous non-small cell lung cancer (first-line, with gemcitabine and cisplatin)
geography: Worldwide (Lilly's worldwide product revenue line in the earnings release)

approval_evidence.quote: Biologic License Application (BLA) : 125547 ... PORTRAZZA NECITUMUMAB 800MG/50ML ... 11/24/2015 ORIG-1 Approval

launch_evidence.quote: Portrazza launched in the U.S. in December 2015.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2015Q4, the launch quarter, read from the prior-year column of the fourth-quarter 2016 release (0.6, equal to the printed twelve months of 2015) because the fourth-quarter 2015 release prints no Portrazza row.
series_end_reason: Lilly's last Portrazza line is in the fourth-quarter 2017 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000005947818000028/q417lillysalesandearningsp.htm: 'Portrazza ® | 2.1 | 3.8 | (44)% | 10.3 | 14.8 | (30)%'). The first-quarter 2018 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000005947818000133/q118lillysalesandearning.htm) carries no product revenue table, the second-quarter 2018 release's 'Selected Revenue Highlights' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/59478/000005947818000186/q218lillysalesandearningsp.htm) list Cyramza, Lartruvo and Verzenio but not Portrazza, and no Lilly Form 10-Q or 10-K ever prints a Portrazza revenue row. Whether Lilly's website workbook printed the product could not be checked (investor.lilly.com: Access Denied).
search_log: Listed every Eli Lilly (CIK 59478) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (all forms). Earnings releases: every 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 from 2001, plus the 2003-2004 releases filed under items 9/12 and the two 2016 releases filed under item 9.01 only (2016-01-28, 2016-04-26), each exhibit resolved from the filing's index.json; plus every 10-Q and 10-K from 2002.

Every HTML table row (and plain-text line for .txt exhibits) whose first cell starts with Baqsimi, Effient, Jaypirca, Portrazza, Reyvow, Strattera or Cymbalta followed by a figure was extracted from all of those documents (scan.py in the work directory); narrative sentences were searched separately where no table row exists.

Each quarter is read from the earnings release that reports it as current (first table row: current quarter, prior-year quarter, then year-to-date); where the release prints no line for the product (no Q1 2006 release was filed on EDGAR; the Q1 2018 release has no product table; releases from 2019 list only selected products), from the Form 10-Q for that quarter (Total column = U.S. + outside U.S.); a fourth quarter with neither is the Form 10-K full year less the third-quarter 10-Q nine-month Total.
Every row was checked offline with verify_staged_manifests.check_row before writing; where a Q4 quote carries a twelve-month figure, the verifier checks the four quarters against it.

Lilly's website Financial Workbooks (investor.lilly.com) could not be checked: the host answers 'Access Denied' to this environment, so whether a workbook continued the product after the last sec.gov quarter is not known.
Portrazza rows: releases for 2016Q1-2017Q4 (incl. the 9.01-only 8-K of 2016-04-26); 2015Q4 from the prior-year column of the 2016Q4 release.
Four-quarter sums: 2016 = 1.7 + 4.0 + 5.3 + 3.8 = 14.8 and 2017 = 3.6 + 2.3 + 2.3 + 2.1 = 10.3, equal to the twelve-month figures of the Q4 2016 and Q4 2017 releases.
